regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing China A-shares thematic field: only 6 of 22 themes are trend-eligible, with AI Compute & Optics as a clear but uncrowded leader (breadth 0.353, mixed Hurst). The backtest explicitly says the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history and rank-IC is ~0, so this is a disciplined-attention read, not an edge.
emerging_watch: Coal (rank 6, eligible, 'mean-revert' Hurst) is worth watching as a potential rotation recipient if the AI/tech leadership stalls, but only if 515220.SS breaks above its 20-day high while Breadth stays ≥0.5 and crowding_z stays below 1.0 — until then it remains a mid-field theme, not a handoff.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the only theme that is simultaneously top-ranked, eligible, uncrowded (z=-0.4), and has a non-trivial breadth (0.353) among the leaders. The durability_bar is middling (0.52) and Hurst is mixed, so the trend is not clean, but it is the least structurally compromised leadership candidate in a narrowing field.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.47 vs challenger Gold at 0.812
breadth=0.353, highest among scorable eligible leaders
rotation.margin=0.658, absorption=0.32 (not one-narrative, so leadership is not overheated)
theses.dissent: The backtest says this market mean-reverts and the trend gate whipsaws; Hurst is 'mixed', meaning the AI theme may be mid-distribution rather than trending, and a weak rank-IC means leadership is attention, not alpha.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and highly ranked (4th) with the best breadth (0.722), but crowding_z=1.58 (crowded=true) is a size-down caution and, combined with mixed Hurst and a market where the trend gate did not hold, argues against initiating a new overweight here. This is an attention read preserved as a caution, not a fade.
evidence: durability_bar=0.63, highest among leaders, but mixed Hurst
theses.dissent: High breadth and the strongest durability_bar suggest Banks could continue to carry if the index holds; avoiding it forfeits exposure to the most cohesive theme.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS makes a new 20-day high with breadth staying above 0.65 for 2 weeks

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is 5th-ranked and eligible with reasonable breadth (0.429), but crowding_z=1.41 (crowded=true) and mixed Hurst make it a late-stage concentration rather than an entry; in a mean-reverting tape this is a cap, not a call.
theses.dissent: The theme is only mildly crowded and has decent breadth; healthcare could be a defensive rotation beneficiary if cyclicals wobble.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms the CSI 300 by 4% with no new crowding flag
